items.quote: Money is only a tool. It will take you wherever you wish, but it will not replace you as the driver.
items.author: Ayn Rand

items.title: Please don't spam people looking for employment. It's just cruel
items.summary: The article urges job seekers to avoid spamming recruiters and hiring managers, highlighting that such unsolicited messages are ineffective and inconsiderate.

items.title: MAI-Code-1-Flash
items.summary: Microsoft has introduced MAI-Code-1-Flash, a new, highly efficient code generation model that offers impressive performance with significantly reduced computational requirements.

items.title: CT scans of BYD car parts
items.summary: Lumafield used CT scans to reveal the intricate internal components of BYD car parts, showcasing advanced manufacturing and design.

items.title: AI outperforms law professors in Stanford Law study
items.summary: A Stanford Law study found that an AI model performed better than law professors on a bar exam-style test, demonstrating its potential in legal education and practice.

items.title: Trump signs downsized AI order after weeks of reversals
items.summary: President Trump signed a scaled-back executive order on artificial intelligence, focusing on workforce development and regulatory reform after initial plans were reportedly altered.

items.title: Agentic Mfw
items.summary: The website "Agentic Mfw" explores the concept of agentic AI, focusing on its potential to act autonomously and creatively, often with a humorous or surprising "mfw" (my face when) reaction.

items.title: MAI-Thinking-1
items.summary: Microsoft has introduced MAI-Thinking-1, a new AI model designed to enhance the reasoning capabilities of large language models, enabling them to tackle more complex tasks.

items.title: How we index images for RAG
items.summary: This article explains how Kapa.ai indexes images for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, focusing on techniques to make visual information searchable and usable for AI.

items.title: Americans don't know how to fight AI so they're fighting data centers
items.summary: Americans are opposing AI's growth by protesting the construction of data centers, as they lack understanding of how to directly address AI's societal impacts.

items.description: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 60-95% fewer tokens, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
items.summary: Headroom is a tool that significantly reduces LLM token usage (60-95%) by compressing outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks, enabling the same answers with fewer tokens, and can function as a library, proxy, or MCP server.

items.description: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.
items.summary: Markitdown is a Python tool that converts various file formats, including Office documents, into Markdown, facilitating content repurposing and integration.

items.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
items.summary: This repository provides an agent harness for performance optimization, focusing on skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for various code generation models.

items.description: 🕷️ An adaptive Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl!
items.summary: Scrapling is an adaptive web scraping framework designed to efficiently handle tasks ranging from single HTTP requests to comprehensive website crawls.

items.description: Hermes WebUI: The best way to use Hermes Agent from the web or from your phone!
items.summary: Hermes WebUI provides a user-friendly web and mobile interface for interacting with the Hermes Agent, simplifying its usage from any device.

items.description: A modern platform for visual, flexible, and extensible graph-based investigations. For cybersecurity analysts and investigators.
items.summary: Flowsint is a modern, visual, and extensible platform designed for cybersecurity analysts to conduct flexible, graph-based investigations.

items.description: VoxCPM2: Tokenizer-Free TTS for Multilingual Speech Generation, Creative Voice Design, and True-to-Life Cloning
items.summary: VoxCPM2 is a tokenizer-free Text-to-Speech model enabling multilingual speech generation, creative voice design, and realistic voice cloning.

items.description: Code for Machine Learning for Algorithmic Trading, 2nd edition.
items.summary: This repository provides Python code for implementing machine learning strategies in algorithmic trading, covering topics from data preprocessing to model evaluation and deployment, as detailed in the "Machine Learning for Algorithmic Trading, 2nd edition" book.
This repository provides a comprehensive course on building production-ready agentic RAG systems, covering core concepts, practical implementation, and deployment strategies.
